settings.text:
Embark on a holiday like no other with Disney Cruise Line, where every journey is filled with world-class entertainment, unmatched service, and family-friendly adventure. Whether you’re cruising with little ones, celebrating a special occasion, or seeking relaxation, Disney Cruise Line offers something for everyone in a setting that combines luxury, fun, and Disney magic.

Onboard, you’ll find a range of dazzling Broadway-style shows, character meet-and-greets, and themed dining experiences that bring Disney stories to life. Enjoy exceptional service from a crew dedicated to making your vacation unforgettable, whether you're relaxing by the pool, indulging in gourmet dining, or experiencing a thrilling onboard activity.

Disney Cruise Line’s fleet of innovative ships offers the perfect mix of excitement and relaxation. Each ship features state-of-the-art amenities, including luxurious staterooms, adult-exclusive areas, and kids’ clubs filled with activities that cater to all ages. Whether you’re looking for a family-friendly retreat or an adults-only escape, Disney’s ships have something to offer.

Set sail to some of the most stunning destinations in the world, including the Caribbean, Alaska, Europe, and the Bahamas—with a special stop at Castaway Cay, Disney’s exclusive private island. Take part in thrilling shore excursions, or simply relax and unwind in paradise, knowing that the magic of Disney is never far away.

No matter where your journey takes you, Disney Cruise Line ensures every detail is taken care of, allowing you to focus on creating memories that will last a lifetime. Whether it's your first cruise or your tenth, Disney Cruise Line promises a vacation experience that’s truly one of a kind.

Ready to set sail? Adventure, enchantment, and magic are waiting for you on a Disney Cruise!

settings.heading: About Our Company
settings.row_content:
Mr Chocolate’s Travel is a premier travel agency specialising in Disney holidays, with a strong emphasis on Disney Cruises. Founded by Rebecca Mason, the agency provides expert travel planning and personalised service for families seeking unforgettable Disney experiences. With a passion for family travel and all things Disney, Mr Chocolate’s Travel helps clients create customised itineraries for a wide range of Disney destinations, including Disney Cruise Line voyages, Disney resorts, and theme park visits.

Rebecca’s background as a mother of six, combined with her entrepreneurial journey, has shaped Mr Chocolate’s Travel into a trusted agency for family-focused vacations. Since launching in 2017, the agency has become a recognised leader in Disney travel, earning a reputation as one of the Top 5 Sellers of Disney Destinations in Australia & New Zealand.

At Mr Chocolate’s Travel, the focus is on providing families with a seamless and magical travel experience. The agency specialises in:

  • Disney Cruise Line: Whether it’s a cruise from Australia, the USA, Europe, or now Singapore, Mr Chocolate's Travel helps families plan the perfect Disney Cruise. From booking cabins to recommending the best itineraries, the team as Mr Chocolate's Travel ensure a stress-free & unforgettable cruise experience.
  • Disney Resorts: For families looking to stay in the heart of the magic, Mr Chocolate’s Travel offers expert advice on choosing the perfect Disney resort, from Walt Disney World to Disneyland and beyond. Whether it’s selecting the best accommodations for large families or helping with dining reservations, the agency provides personalised service every step of the way.
  • Customised Itineraries: The agency specialises in crafting bespoke Disney holidays that fit each family’s unique needs. From coordinating park tickets and reservations to creating detailed daily itineraries, Mr Chocolate’s Travel ensures families get the most out of their Disney adventure.

Mr Chocolate’s Travel is dedicated to providing top-tier customer service, offering a personal touch that larger travel agencies can’t match. With expert knowledge of Disney Cruise Line’s offerings and all things Disney, the agency goes above and beyond to make sure every vacation is as magical and stress-free as possible.

By focusing on Disney destinations and cruises, Mr Chocolate’s Travel ensures that each family receives a fully customised experience, making Disney’s iconic blend of entertainment, luxury, and adventure accessible to families of all sizes. Whether it’s a Disney Cruise to a tropical paradise or a stay at a Disney Resort, Mr Chocolate’s Travel is here to turn your Disney dreams into reality.  We are Australia's Disney Experts.

settings.heading: Why Mr Chocolate's Travel?
settings.row_content:
At Mr Chocolate’s Travel, we offer personalized and expert services to ensure your experience aboard the Disney Adventure ship is seamless, magical, and stress-free. Here’s why you should book your Disney Adventure cruise with us:

  • Best Fare Sourcing: We find the best available fares for your Disney Adventure cruise, tailored to meet your travel needs and budget.
  • Stateroom Hold: We secure the best stateroom options available for you on the Disney Adventure, with same-day holds to ensure your preferred room is reserved.
  • Cruise Line Liaison: We handle all communications with Disney Cruise Line, saving you time on the phone and ensuring your needs are met efficiently.
  • Stateroom & Dining Requests: We manage your stateroom preferences, dining reservations, and any special service requests for your Disney Adventure cruise.
  • Special Service Requests: From dietary requirements to accessibility needs, we make sure all special requests are handled so you can fully enjoy your cruise.
  • Cruise Disruption Management: Should any last-minute changes occur, we deal directly with Disney Cruise Line on your behalf, ensuring you don’t have to worry about disruptions.
  • Documentation & Border Requirements: We liaise with the cruise line on all current border pass, vaccination, and document requirements for your Disney Adventure cruise.
  • 24/7 Support: You’ll have 24/7 support from our team while traveling, ensuring that everything goes smoothly during your time on the Disney Adventure.
  • Destination Expertise: We provide tailored suggestions for experiences at your cruise’s ports of call, ensuring you make the most of your time at each destination.
  • Electronic & Paper Documentation: We supply you with all necessary travel documents for your Disney Adventure cruise, including electronic tickets, paper documentation, and lanyards for convenience.
  • Flexible Payment Options: We allow for part payments of your Disney Adventure cruise booking through your preferred payment methods, making budgeting easy.
  • Shore Excursion Assistance: We help you book shore excursions at the various ports of call for your Disney Adventure cruise, with exclusive suggestions and insider tips.
  • Exclusive Disney Knowledge: Join our pre-cruise information sessions where we share our extensive Disney expertise, offering tips and recommendations specifically for the Disney Adventure ship.
  • Specialty Dining & Experiences: We assist in booking specialty dining and exclusive onboard experiences, ensuring you have a memorable time on the Disney Adventure.
  • US Dollar Conversion Fee Absorbed: We absorb the US Dollar conversion fee and price-fix the balance of your cruise in Australian Dollars, so you can budget with confidence.

When you book your Disney Adventure cruise with Mr. Chocolate’s Travel, you’ll receive expert advice and personalized service from start to finish, making sure your experience on this magical ship is smooth, enjoyable, and filled with Disney magic.
